anyOf.description: Direct TypeSafe connection (Jev reviewer). Both baseUrl and apiKey are optional: unset values fall back to TYPESAFE_BASE_URL / TYPESAFE_API_KEY, then the SDK built-in default URL.

fallbacks.description: Ordered backup reviewers in any lane (defaults to none). Chat-model entries use Pi registry provider/model ids; System One entries carry their own URL, key and model.

maxTokens.description: Reviewer reply budget in tokens. Thinking blocks count against it on reasoning upstreams; too small a cap truncates the reply mid-think (the empty-reply machinery failure).

mode.description: The leniency ladder for the reviewer's non-allow verdicts, strictest first. Hard-tier denies (riskLevel high|critical, or missing) always deny. Soft-tier denies (low/medium) and the model's own uncertainty (split by its lean: benign-leaned, neutral, danger-leaned) map per mode: 'strict' — everything denies, the reviewer's allow is the only pass; 'default' — you judge every flag but hard danger (soft denies and every unresolved doubt ask); 'lenient' — benign and neutral doubts pass, soft denies and danger-leaned doubts ask; 'permissive' — everything passes except hard-tier denies. Reviewer machinery failures never map to allow: they deny under strict and permissive, and defer otherwise.

notifyLevel.description: The minimum ambient (review-loop) notification level that still notifies the operator; 'off' silences all ambient notices. Command feedback (the /ai-guard surface) is never gated. With denials having no host dialog, 'off' or 'warning' means model denies (and clarifications, at 'warning') reach only the agent and the audit log.

notifyApprovals.description: Opt in to info-level notices when AI Guard emits an allow (fresh or cached). Fresh reviews carry their total review cost in a duration tail; cache replays say (cached). Mapped allows name the mode (`mode (permissive) auto-approved`); path and external_directory families are excluded because the host caps their allows to defer. Subject to notifyLevel; commands and targets are never shown.

anyOf.description: Jev-mode overlay (object providers only): shared background plus per-question additions keyed by stable question id (danger_category, intent_match, risk). LLM mode accepts only the string form.

intentThreshold.description: Intent probability at or above which the anchor counts as authorizing the action.

riskThreshold.description: Risk score at or above which the action denies (soft tier). Raising it widens what auto-allows in every mode.

confidenceThreshold.description: Minimum answer confidence; below it the verdict defers.

timeoutMs.description: SDK timeout per attempt (one attempt per endpoint when fallbacks are configured). Falls back to top-level timeoutMs when omitted.
